purpose: Manual/model forward-test requests and acceptance criteria. These are not fabricated completed articles or automatically executed semantic tests.

input.title: Why Pixel Art Displays Look Different Up Close and Across a Room

must: Explain perception versus unchanged physical grid
Do not become shopping comparison or device settings tutorial

input.title: How to Choose a Digital Photo Frame for a Shared Family Living Room

must: Evaluate whether current solution already suffices
Define task-based exclusion criteria before candidates
No invented model features or prices

input.title: Pixel Art Speakers vs Bluetooth Speakers for a Small Desk: Which Fits the Task?

must: Both sides in each decision axis
Conditional conclusions; no unconditional winner
Repeated necessary references to both objects are not banned as extra product placement

input.title: How to Set Up a Digital Photo Frame for a Shared Household

must: Identify prerequisites and applicable model capabilities
Actions include observable validation and fallback
No imagined common app menu for all models

input.title: Digital Photo Frame Not Receiving Photos: What to Check First

must: Symptom routes and reversible checks
Distinguish network connection from successful content delivery
Stop and escalation conditions

input.title: Does Higher Brightness Really Make a Pixel Art Display Easier to Read?

must: Distinguish claim support, confounders, uncertainty
Retain candidate FX status rather than claim verified Momcozy formula
No invented numeric optimum

input.title: Why Pixel Art Displays Look Different Up Close and Across a Room
input.condition: No relevant published explanatory blog exists

must: No invented slug or empty href
Pending opportunity stays internal
Category link only if existing sentence genuinely warrants it

input.condition: A source is HTTP200 but discusses a different model

must: Do not mark target model capability supported
Find appropriate source or narrow/delete claim

input.condition: Relevant URL is blocked or returns403

must: Do not claim verified or fabricate status
Use inspectable authoritative alternative or omit link
Core unsupported claim blocks export

input.condition: pixel display and pixel art display refer to the same appropriate collection

must: Allow same genuine collection for natural keyword variants
Do not create one fake collection per phrase

input.condition: Entity vocabulary lists a capability but chosen model manual does not establish it

must: Do not infer model support from general vocabulary
Verify applicable official source; otherwise remove assertion

input.condition: Link insertion changes a causal or numeric claim

must: Update evidence and reseal draft
Invalidate later links/review
Do not treat link stage as exempt from fact review

input.condition: A new FAQ is appended after review

must: Invalidate old review
Review final complete content before export

input.condition: Existing Liquid template already outputs H1 author TOC disclaimer and recommendation cards

must: Do not duplicate fixed modules in body
Do not automatically use cover as first banner
No invented banner URL
No we tested or invented user result
Evaluate experience through grounded observable situations rather than fabricated credentials

input.condition: Existing publisher controls hidden status and scheduling

must: No published/published_at/status/schedule fields
No publishing or backend calls
Deliver one blog-array JSON only

input.condition: F1 watts article; the latest UI discussion referenced a pregnancy-travel page.

must: Read the registered F1 high-chair sample before outlining.
Do not substitute the travel guide or use it to require FAQs.

input.condition: Two adjacent sections each have four paragraphs but answer distinct questions.

must: Judge incremental information, not equal paragraph count.
Merge only actual repetition.

input.condition: The draft repeats the same advice for desks, bedrooms and travel.

must: Keep only scenarios with a changed condition and different observation or conclusion.
State controlled conditions; no invented experiment.

input.condition: The F1 body answers the core question and there is no new relevant FAQ.

must: Permit no FAQ with a reason.
Do not add FAQ to satisfy sample frequency or scoring.

input.condition: A photo shows spoon feeding while alt claims bottle feeding.

must: Inspect pixels and correct the description.
Do not treat alt as authoritative visual evidence.

input.condition: A necessary explanatory figure has been planned but no asset exists.

must: Keep the plan internal and body self-contained.
Do not invent a CDN URL or insert prompts/placeholders.

input.condition: A proposed generated frequency-response graph has no measured source.

must: Do not fabricate numeric curves.
Use explicitly conceptual diagrams or verified data with conditions.

input.condition: A title-heavy OG cover is proposed as the article H1 background.

must: Separate listing cover, banner and body figure.
Do not duplicate baked-in heading text or silently use the cover as banner.

input.condition: A new mastitis claim-review article was found while the registered F14 URL is unknown.

must: Keep the original mapping unverified.
Label the new article supplementary candidate; do not claim recovery of the original.
